no_data.reason: The file contains no usable data

one_line.reason: The file contains only one line and may not follow a tabular structure with delimited fields

no_delimiter_detected.reason: The file does not appear to contain a valid delimiter and may not follow a tabular structure with delimited fields

skip_rows.reason: The file contains SKIPPED_ROWS initial non-data lines that were skipped to reach the tabular content

invalid_request.reason: The server rejected the download request due to a malformed or invalid URL (HTTP 400 - Bad Request)

forbidden_resource.reason: Access to the resource was denied (HTTP 403 - Forbidden)

missing_resource.reason: The resource was not found on the server (HTTP 404 - Not Found)
